skimage.filters.threshold_multiotsu.description: Generate `classes`-1 threshold values to divide gray levels in `image`,

branches.expression: image is not None and image.ndim > 2 and (image.shape[-1] in (3, 4))

skimage.filters.threshold_multiotsu.inspection: Literal Python entry-point facts only; helper calls and compiled kernels must be read through their source references, not inferred to be numerically equivalent.
